# appleads_search_term_report (Data Source)

Reads Apple Ads search-term performance for a campaign (optionally scoped to an ad group).

Read-only snapshot from `POST /api/v5/reports/campaigns/{campaignId}/searchterms` or `POST /api/v5/reports/campaigns/{campaignId}/adgroups/{adgroupId}/searchterms` when `ad_group_id` is set. Apple requires `time_zone` `ORTZ` (organization time zone); that is the default. Search terms typically appear only after about 10 impressions. Observational only: do not drive bids from this data source in the same apply without care.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Campaign-scoped search-term report (Apple requires ORTZ; that is the default).
data "appleads_search_term_report" "campaign" {
  campaign_id = "1234567890"
  start_time  = "2026-09-01"
  end_time    = "2026-09-14"
}

# Ad-group-scoped search-term report.
data "appleads_search_term_report" "ad_group" {
  campaign_id = "1234567890"
  ad_group_id = "9876543210"
  start_time  = "2026-09-01"
  end_time    = "2026-09-14"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `campaign_id` (String) Parent campaign id.
- `end_time` (String) Report end date (`YYYY-MM-DD`).
- `start_time` (String) Report start date (`YYYY-MM-DD`).

### Optional

- `ad_group_id` (String) When set, scopes the report to this ad group.
- `time_zone` (String) Report time zone. Defaults to `ORTZ` (required by Apple for search-term reports).

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Composite id `campaign_id[/ad_group_id]/start_time/end_time`.
- `search_terms` (Attributes List) Search-term rows for the window. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--search_terms))

<a id="nestedatt--search_terms"></a>
### Nested Schema for `search_terms`

Read-Only:

- `ad_group_id` (String) Ad group id for the row.
- `ad_group_name` (String) Ad group name for the row.
- `avg_cpa_amount` (String) Average CPA / CPI as a decimal string (`totalAvgCPI`).
- `avg_cpa_currency` (String) Average CPA currency.
- `avg_cpt_amount` (String) Average CPT as a decimal string.
- `avg_cpt_currency` (String) Average CPT currency.
- `bid_amount` (String) Keyword bid amount as a decimal string, when present.
- `bid_currency` (String) Keyword bid currency, when present.
- `conversion_rate` (Number) Conversion rate.
- `deleted` (Boolean) Whether the matched keyword is deleted.
- `impressions` (Number) Impressions in the report window.
- `installs` (Number) Total installs (tap + view) in the report window.
- `keyword` (String) Matched keyword text.
- `keyword_id` (String) Matched keyword id.
- `local_spend_amount` (String) Spend as a decimal string.
- `local_spend_currency` (String) Spend currency.
- `match_type` (String) EXACT or BROAD.
- `search_term_text` (String) Search term text.
- `taps` (Number) Taps in the report window.
- `ttr` (Number) Tap-through rate.
